title: Bug ?? Connected to power but NS not uploading
body:
I'm not sure if it is a bug or an Android limitation...

NS set to upload _when charging_ only. The phone is connected to power but the battery is full => NS doesn't upload. 

Technically, the phone isn't charging (as the battery is full) but it is still connected to external power.

It would be logical to still upload in this case as the "limitation" is there to limit battery drain and with power connected, there is no drain on battery.
